messages:
Maria (PM): Heads up — enterprise pilot with Vertica is asking for 99.99% SLA for Dedicated GA. Need alignment on what that actually means operationally and commercially. Who can triage impact? @ajay @sam

Ajay (Eng): Quick note — our current Dedicated SLO target is 99.9% (windowed). 99.99% requires at least 10x reduction in error budget. Main issues: cold-starts for large models + region failover. I'll add perf numbers in a sec.

Sam (SRE): Agree. Ops work: cross-region replication, faster failover, and pre-warm pools. We also need alert tuning: want to avoid noisy pagers. Proposed alert: `service_error_rate > 0.1% for 10m` instead of current 0.5%. Thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): Perf snapshot: p99 latency on current pools = 320ms for seq=1024, p95=90ms. Tail artifacts from `kv cache` warmup and preemption. TODOs: 1) pre-warm hot pools, 2) reserve bump for GA load and 3) faster eviction policy. Will draft RFC with numbers.

Lina (Support): Documentation gaps: runbooks for oncall, customer-facing SLA doc, escalation matrix. We need canned responses and a billing grace explanation. Can we get draft by EOD Wed?

Jordan (FinOps): Pricing callout — 99.99% requires reservation & premium SLO pricing. Recommend offer: tiered SLA: 99.9% (standard) vs 99.99% (premium) with ~1.8x price, plus a minimum commit. Also add commercial backstop for capacity bursts.

Maria (PM): Owners: Ajay = perf fixes/engineering plan, Sam = runbooks/alert matrix, Lina = customer docs + support kit, Jordan = pricing proposal + contract language. Deadline: next Tues for internal sign-off; external answer by Thu. Can everyone ack?

Ajay (Eng): Ack. Adding a short RFC with perf remediation list.

Sam (SRE): Ack. I'll draft runbook snippets and propose SLO burn policy.

Lina (Support): Ack. Will start doc skeleton and sample KB articles.

Jordan (FinOps): Ack. I'll model unit economics and draft pricing tiers.

deploy-bot: smoke checks passed on staging at 1768412380 — `smoke: ok` :white_check_mark:

Maria (PM): Quick follow: fallback policy — we should define automatic model variant fallback (quantized queue) when capacity constrained. Ajay can you include in RFC? :eyes:

Ajay (Eng): Yup — `fallback: quantized-1 -> quantized-2 -> small-model` in that order. Will include cost delta table.

Sam (SRE): Also we need observability retention decision: premium SLA customers get 90d traces vs 30d default. That impacts storage and cost.

Jordan (FinOps): Noted — include storage uplift in pricing model.

Lina (Support): For the KB we'll include "what to expect during failover" and "SLA credits flow".

Maria (PM): Ok, let's reconvene Mon 10am PT for pre-signoff. If anyone can't make, drop notes here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
